headlines: NVDA is the one to watch. It's inside a flip zone that has been moving ($153–162), under its largest $177.5 level (+49.8K). There's almost no support below it, and none at all around $150. It's net negative into opex (−95.6K), so swings are likely to be bigger.
AAPL has the most positioning into opex (+234K), centred on $360–365. The 11/18 expiry is net negative, though, so the next few sessions could be choppy. It's also sitting on its $353 flip.

TSLA faces resistance at $395–400 (and it's sitting on its $377–388 flip zone), AMZN at $265–270 (and it's sitting on its $254–267 flip zone), and AVGO at $347.5–380 (and it's sitting on its $332–345 flip zone).
TSM closed below its flip ($377–398), with net negative positioning into opex, so moves can run until it gets back above.
Looking to the 12/18 opex, AAPL has the most positioning (+118K); NVDA, GOOGL, and TSM stay net negative into both opex dates; AVGO flips from positive this month to negative.
GOOGL is the weakest board, at −144K into opex. It's below its $292 flip, and TradeEcho rates it 2/5.
